<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2003|month=09|day=30|content=
* [[Air France]] and [[KLM]] are completing their merger.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/business/3150928.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Business - European airlines join forces|publisher=|accessdate=17 October 2015}}</ref>
* [[European Union|EU]] [[European Commission|Agriculture Commissioner]], [[Franz Fischler]] urged EU ministers to lift the ban on [[GMO food]], as the EU risks facing legal challenges by the US and other countries at the [[World Trade Organization]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12859 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050228233550/http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12859 |archive-date=2005-02-28 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* Russia stalls on signing the [[Kyoto Protocol]], the international treaty to reduce [[global warming]]. Kyoto Protocol supporters in the EU react with consternation to Russia's decision.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12858 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050228233855/http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12858 |archive-date=2005-02-28 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* EU [[foreign minister]]s have approved a controversial [[pension]] reform for EU [[civil servant]]s, which is set to increase their pension age and make the new entrants work more years to receive the maximum level of pension.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12862 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050228233945/http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12862 |archive-date=2005-02-28 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[European Union]]: Poland and Spain are about to launch their battle to keep the current system of voting in the [[European Council]], introduced by the Nice Treaty.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12873 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050607182312/http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12873 |archive-date=2005-06-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[European Parliament|Euro-parliamentarians]] urge EU governments to form a united front and protest against US President [[George W. Bush]] over the lack of rights of detainees in the US base in [[Guantánamo Bay, Cuba|Guantanamo Bay]], Cuba.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12876 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050228233744/http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12876 |archive-date=2005-02-28 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* The [[European Commission]] will not shy away from imposing fines on France if it continues to break [[Euro]]-rules, according to Economics Commissioner [[Pedro Solbes]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12869 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050228234009/http://www.euobserver.com/index.phtml?sid=9&aid=12869 |archive-date=2005-02-28 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
